app.eyebrow: SVG vector files · PNG export · processed locally
app.title: QR Code Generator with SVG and PNG
app.lede: Turn a URL, text, Wi-Fi setting, or contact detail into a QR code. Download a crisp vector SVG or PNG; everything stays in your browser.
app.placeholder: Example: https://qr.maxlin.tw, or enter other content
app.empty: Enter content to generate a QR code locally.
app.helpTitle: A usable QR code in seconds
app.stepOneText: Paste a URL, text, Wi-Fi setting, or contact detail.
app.stepTwoText: Medium suits most uses; choose high when it may be printed or obscured.
app.stepThreeText: SVG is ideal for print. PNG is ideal for slides and digital assets.
app.usesText: Use a QR code for web links, event check-in, menus, business cards, Wi-Fi sharing, presentations, and print. SVG stays sharp when enlarged for print, while PNG is convenient for digital assets. Test it on a phone before publishing to check the content and size.
app.faqPrivacyQuestion: Do I need to upload my content?
app.faqPrivacyAnswer: No. The QR code is created in your browser and your input is not sent to a server.
app.faqFormatQuestion: What is the difference between SVG and PNG QR codes?
app.faqFormatAnswer: SVG is a vector format that stays sharp when enlarged for print. PNG is convenient for slides, social posts, and everyday documents.
app.faqCorrectionQuestion: Which error correction level should I use?
app.faqCorrectionAnswer: Medium works for most uses. Choose high or best if the code may be printed, partly covered, or exposed to wear.
app.error: This content is too long for the selected QR settings.
